about: Modwerk source-only digiperform packages for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/digiperform.

mods.title: Digi Perform
mods.summary: Eight performance macros on knobs A-H: each moves one track parameter, the same parameter of every track, or a MIDI track's CC, per pattern.
mods.description: Eight performance macros on knobs A-H, each adding an offset to one track parameter, the same parameter of every track, or a MIDI track's CC value. The Perform page is the second page of the TRIG page; assignments are made on the page (FUNC and a knob's push) or in SETTINGS > PERFORM EDIT, kept per pattern in the sound records' spare bytes and through a power cycle.
mods.author: ROMsets
mods.on_unit: Tested by its author on a unit, OS 1.53 (full checklist) and 1.54 (smoke test), alone and beside CC Names (see TESTING.md).
